_comment: SD pre-reduce EWL — OPTIMISM PROBE, channel_mode = single.  Paired with its sibling
_sdewl_probe_$( [ single = single ] && echo all || echo single )10.json; the ONLY functional key between them is
processing.channel_mode, so a residual difference is attributable to the arc<->state
CHANNEL correspondence and nothing else.  10 epochs, 50 stations, GPS+Galileo.
GPS-only was the requested roster but is BLOCKED on this arm set independently of this
card: the NetworkSbasis null-space gate withholds every epoch with 'observed 1
(near-)zero eigenvalue but the declared S-basis dimension is 2 — the datum is
over-specified'.  declared_dimension is one clock pin per constellation, so declared=2
under 'Active systems: GPS' is itself the anomaly.  Separate card; GPS+Gal keeps the
validated datum so this probe measures the channel lever alone.
MEASURE-ONLY: sigma_floor_m = 1000 makes each row's information ~1e-6, so the rows are
traced but do not perturb the x_lin whose residual is being measured.  max_abs_z_m = 0
leaves the full residual population visible.
min_arc_epochs = 2 so rows arm at epoch 3 inside a 10-epoch window.
